short_description: Experimental neuroanatomy trait retained for research inspection of right-thalamus-volume score behavior within the strict no-imputation raw-array workflow; it is not consumer-ready.
summary_note: Experimental non-consumer neuroanatomy trait used to inspect how a right-thalamus-volume-related score behaves under the current strict raw-array workflow without imputation.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with the bundled right-thalamus-volume score, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel for research inspection only.
interpretation_template: This is an experimental research-facing output, not a brain scan, not a cognitive assessment, and not a substitute for clinical or imaging evaluation. {interpretation}
caution_text: Experimental research output only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the result should not be treated as a diagnosis, a brain-health assessment, or medical advice.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
This trait is not consumer-ready and should stay in research review unless a separate product decision is made.

Real-world thalamic volume depends on age, development, brain injury, imaging protocol, disease processes, and many environmental and biological factors, so this output should not be read as a deterministic neuroanatomy forecast.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about real-world thalamic anatomy.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative research values, not population-wide or clinical benchmarks.
